items.video_description:
Buying a new car, need some guidance, use out paid chat service. Fill this form :  https://forms.gle/CWc2ybpauvgtEAtW8
Which transmission is best for you? In this video, we compare all major car transmission types – Manual Transmission (MT), Automatic Transmission (AT), Automated Manual Transmission (AMT), Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT), Dual-Clutch Transmission (DCT), and Intelligent Manual Transmission (iMT).
In this video we will breakdown all the major types of transmissions systems
Manual transmission, automatic transmission with torque converter, AMT, CVT, DCT, IMT. 
We will learn about their basic working, advantages and disadvantages, and find out the best transmission among all.

Timestamps
0:00 Intro
0:37 Types of Transmission
0:52 Manual Transmission
2:04 AT (Automatic Transmission)
3:06 CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission)
4:04 DCT (Dual Clutch Transmission)
5:46 AMT (Automated Manual Transmission)
6:39 IMT (Intelligent Manual Transmission)
7:30 Comparison Table 


Whether you’re buying a new car or just curious, this video helps you understand:

How each transmission works

Which is best for city or highway

Fuel efficiency & maintenance cost

Which gearbox suits your driving style

items.video_title: Manual vs Automatic vs CVT Transmission ⚙️ | Types of Car Transmission 🧑‍🔧
items.video_description:
Cars use different transmission systems to transfer engine power to the wheels. ⚙️🚗

🔧 Manual Transmission — Uses a driver-operated clutch and selectable gears.

⚙️ Automatic Transmission — Uses a torque converter and planetary gear sets to change ratios automatically.

🔄 CVT — Uses variable-diameter pulleys and a belt/chain system to provide a continuously variable ratio.

Each system has a different design, driving feel, efficiency, and application.

Secondly
